title: Resolve indexed workspace paths for shared MSBuild Exists conditions
outcome: Exists('web.config') and other safe workspace-relative conditions use pinned indexed presence without restricting probes to MSBuild import files.
acceptance: All existing evaluator limits remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
Existing import traversal remains restricted to supported .props/.targets files.
Exists resolves any safe workspace-relative path from the pinned index, including web.config, without reading the live filesystem.
Focused regressions, full gates, and one final dual-agent review pass.
Positive and negative probes are captured for invalidation identity.

completion.summary: Delivered indexed `Exists('web.config')` support for bounded F# MSBuild evaluation using pinned index presence without live filesystem reads, with fail-closed unknown handling, invalidation identity, v0.12.92 capability/version contract, decisive regressions, full green gates, and same-session dual-review clearance.
